initial.label: Random Initialization (Before Training)
initial.description: These are the completely random numbers PyTorch assigned when the model was first created. They mean nothing yet!

after_row1.label: After Training on Row 1
after_row1.description: We fed the first training example ([20.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 3.0]) with expected answer 23.0 through the network 50 times. Watch how the weights shifted!

after_row2.label: After Training on Row 2
after_row2.description: We then fed the second training example ([8.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 7.0]) with expected answer 1.0. The weights shifted again to accommodate both examples!

final.label: After Full Training (10,000 rows × 15,000 epochs)
final.description: After seeing the entire dataset thousands of times, the weights have sculpted themselves into a precise calculator. Compare these to the random initial values above!
